customer_id.meaning: primary id of the household account record (content hash)

verified.meaning: whether the caller cleared identity verification; once true it never returns to false

pass_id.meaning: primary id of the season pass record

closed_date.meaning: last date the plan could be spent; empty while the plan is still live

dining_balance_usd.meaning: spending power left on this plan; identically the sum of the signed deltas booked to the dining balance account, so loads and bonuses raise it and spending and returns lower it

plan_fee_balance_usd.meaning: plan fees still to be collected; identically the sum of the signed deltas booked to the plan fee account

auto_top_up_enabled.meaning: whether the plan presents a top-up of its own when the balance falls below the trigger

suspension_reason.meaning: why spending was stopped; none while spending is open

cancellation_reason.meaning: why the plan was given up; none while the plan has not been cancelled

dining_event_id.meaning: primary id of the dining account entry

dining_plan_id.meaning: the dining plan this entry belongs to (foreign key -> dining_holdings)

customer_id.meaning: the household account this entry belongs to (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: the dining account entry family this row records, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the charter

related_event_id.meaning: the single dining account entry this row answers to — the load a bonus is earned on, the fee a payment settles, the load a return is worked out from; empty where the row stands alone

season_code.meaning: the season this entry falls in

event_date.meaning: date the occurrence this row records took place

period_start_date.meaning: first date a statement covers; empty on entries that are not statements

period_end_date.meaning: last date a statement covers; empty on entries that are not statements

amount_usd.meaning: money moved by this entry, always recorded as a positive figure whose direction is given by the entry family; on a statement it is the balance standing at the end of the period

charge_category.meaning: which plan fee the amount is for; empty on entries that are not plan fees

load_channel.meaning: where a load was made; none on entries that are not loads or bonuses

payment_method.meaning: how money was taken or returned; none where the entry moves no outside money

credit_reason.meaning: why a balance was returned; none where the entry does not return balance

outlet.meaning: outlet a card was presented at; none on entries not raised at an outlet

mountain.meaning: mountain the outlet stands at; empty on entries not tied to a mountain

card_serial.meaning: serial of the card presented; empty on entries where no card was presented

item_category.meaning: what kind of goods a transaction covered; none on entries that are not transactions

dining_request_id.meaning: primary id of the dining plan service request record

customer_id.meaning: household account the request was raised for (foreign key -> customers)

dining_plan_id.meaning: the dining plan the request concerns (foreign key -> dining_holdings)

request_type.meaning: what the household has asked the collective to do with the plan

disputed_event_id.meaning: the single dining account entry the household disputes; empty where the request is not a dispute

stated_reason.meaning: the reason the household gives for the request, as they state it and before any record confirms it

outcome.meaning: where the request stands; a request is accepted at the desk and only becomes effective once the household confirms it

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
